- **LA지점이 최다**: 1위 **LA지점(140명)**이고, 2위(강남보상SC 구상, 45명)와 **격차가 95명**으로 큽니다.

- **분포가 ‘긴 꼬리(long tail)’ 형태**: 상위는 수십 명 단위인 반면, 이후에는 **1~2명대 부서도 여러 곳** 보입니다. 즉, 소수 인원이 속한 부서들이 다수인 구조입니다.

  COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_id) AS total_employee_cnt,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.work_status = '퇴직' THEN e.emp_id END) AS retire_employee_cnt,
  ROUND(

SELECT
  department,
  emp_type,
  emp_count,
  ROUND(emp_count / NULLIF(SUM(emp_count) OVER (), 0), 4) AS ratio_overall,
  ROUND(emp_count / NULLIF(SUM(emp_count) OVER (PARTITION BY department), 0), 4) AS ratio_in_department
FROM (
  SELECT
    NVL(e.department, '미상') AS department,
    e.emp_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_id) AS emp_count
  FROM v_ai_employee e
  WHERE e.work_status = '재직'
    AND e.emp_type IN ('정규직', '기간제')
  GROUP BY
    NVL(e.department, '미상'),
    e.emp_type
)
ORDER BY emp_count DESC, department, emp_type

SELECT
  tenure_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT EMP_ID) AS employee_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN CAREER_YEARS < 1 THEN '1년미만'
      WHEN CAREER_YEARS BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1~3년'
      WHEN CAREER_YEARS > 3 AND CAREER_YEARS <= 5 THEN '3~5년'
      WHEN CAREER_YEARS > 5 AND CAREER_YEARS <= 10 THEN '5~10년'
      WHEN CAREER_YEARS > 10 THEN '10년이상'
      ELSE '기타'
    END AS tenure_group,
    EMP_ID
  FROM v_ai_employee
  WHERE WORK_STATUS = '재직'
)
GROUP BY tenure_group
ORDER BY
  CASE tenure_group
    WHEN '1년미만' THEN 1
    WHEN '1~3년' THEN 2
    WHEN '3~5년' THEN 3
    WHEN '5~10년' THEN 4
    WHEN '10년이상' THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END DESC, tenure_group DESC
